review_scope.limits: Source-claim review, operational approval and independent evaluation are separate. No approval of every current edge or response is asserted.

status_definitions.supported: Explicitly supported as a statement of the cited source, under its scope and limitations; not independent cultural or empirical verification.
status_definitions.explicit_negative: The cited source explicitly denies a specified feature; not absence inferred from missing data.
status_definitions.unverified: Relevant candidate claim not established in the reviewed project evidence; not declared false.
status_definitions.discrepancy: Source-language wording or specificity differs and remains unresolved; not necessarily a logical contradiction or proven translation error.

triple_contract.subject_and_entity_objects: Stable English snake_case identifiers; graph nodes may be derived later.
triple_contract.negative_semantics: A negative triple denies that specific relation only, within scope. Do not double-negate it or apply a closed-world assumption.
triple_contract.name_relation_policy: Use source-scoped labels and candidate aliases; no unconditional sameAs/disjointWith.
triple_contract.unverified_records_policy: Kemetek has no asserted factual triples and no evidence quote. Its course candidate metadata is separate.
triple_contract.discrepancy_policy: Keep both language-specific wording triples. Tail presence for form2 is the shared supported subclaim.
triple_contract.inference_policy: Direct subtype evidence has priority. Class-most statements remain context only; missing subtype evidence is not_documented, not automatically positive or negative.
triple_contract.classification_policy: Source-scoped is_a links express class membership, not alias identity or disjointness.
triple_contract.class_majority_policy: most_have is qualified class context. It is never a hard inherited positive feature on a subtype.

counts.interpretation: Record and triple counts describe the representation, not correctness scores, independent observations or cultural completeness.

Wau Kikik juga dikenali sebagai Wau Kaca disebabkan penggunaan serbuk kaca pada talinya yang bertujuan untuk memutuskan tali wau pihak lawan.

records.limits_en: These are language-specific statements of intended competitive purpose in the 2002 book, not a guaranteed outcome or a claim about every present-day kite. The glass is on the string, not the body. The English word “defeat” is not silently treated as the word “cut”.

intent_taxonomy.rule: Intent is retrieval metadata, not a new assertion. Missing evidence routes to not_documented and never creates a fact.

evidence_language_policy.rule: English is the primary answer and evidence language. Malay verbatim evidence is included where it clarifies wording, negation or purpose. A record scoped to pp.72–73 need not contain duplicate quotations from both languages; each quotation retains its actual page and language. Metadata and paraphrases are in English.
